allow_instructions: Shell commands that only run the repo test suite, a single test file, lint, typecheck, format-check, or skillsync tools under .cursor/vendor/skillsync/tools/ (run-verification, re-break, validate-state, tdd-audit) may run without asking.
Read-only git commands (status, diff, log, show, rev-parse) may run without asking.
Editing source and test files under the project tree for the active RED→GREEN cycle may proceed without asking.
block_instructions: Any command that reads or writes .env, credentials, secrets, or SSH keys must ask for approval.
git push --force, git reset --hard, and production deploys must ask for approval.
Installing global packages or changing Cursor/Paseo user config outside the repo must ask for approval.
